title: Phối hợp thì trong tường thuật
learningObjectiveVi: Phối hợp past simple, past continuous và past perfect để phân tầng sự kiện, bối cảnh và hồi tưởng.
learningObjectiveEn: Coordinate past simple, past continuous, and past perfect to layer events, background, and flashback.

morphologyNotes: Tense shifts must follow changes in temporal viewpoint rather than vary only for stylistic effect.

uses: Control foreground and background in a narrative.
Move to an earlier time without losing sequence.

usageConstraints: The structure must be motivated by meaning, information flow, stance, or register rather than complexity alone.

rules.description: Tense shifts must follow changes in temporal viewpoint rather than vary only for stylistic effect.

examples.english: The wind was rising as we reached the house.
examples.vietnamese: Gió đang mạnh lên khi chúng tôi đến ngôi nhà.
examples.explanationVi: Ví dụ minh họa đúng mục tiêu phối hợp thì trong tường thuật.
